aiFeatureRecognition.2.detail: Pull every photo of a given spokesperson without depending on whether anyone tagged them before.
aiFeatureRecognition.3.name: Nameable and Correctable
aiFeatureRecognition.3.detail: Name the recognised features and fix any misassigned assets; later clustering follows your corrections.
professionalPrint.title: Creative Production (IngenOps) · Professional Print
professionalPrint.0.name: Complete Prepress Settings
professionalPrint.0.detail: Bleed, crop marks and other prepress parameters produce files that can go straight to print.
professionalPrint.1.name: Professional Colour Management
professionalPrint.1.detail: CMYK and spot colours keep what you see on screen consistent with the printed result.
professionalPrint.2.name: Print-Ready Output
professionalPrint.2.detail: Files are exported to print standards and can be handed to the printer without further conversion.
htmlExport.title: Creative Production (IngenOps) · HTML Export
htmlExport.0.name: Design Straight to HTML
htmlExport.0.detail: Turn a design into an HTML asset in one click, with no front-end rebuild.
htmlExport.1.name: Automatic Device Adaptation
htmlExport.1.detail: Desktop and mobile adapt automatically while the visual stays consistent.
htmlExport.2.name: Ready for Digital Channels
htmlExport.2.detail: Output can be delivered to websites, landing pages, email campaigns and similar channels.
clipoRemix.0.name: Batch Remixing
clipoRemix.0.detail: Generate remix scripts automatically, match usable shots from the asset library, then add voiceover and music to produce videos at scale.
clipoRemix.1.name: End-to-End Assembly
clipoRemix.1.detail: Script, storyboard, voiceover, music and final edit run as one connected flow, drawing on existing library content throughout.
clipoRemix.2.name: Reuse What Works
clipoRemix.2.detail: Break a high-performing video down into a template and reuse the same structure to produce new cuts quickly.
clipoRemix.3.name: Digital Humans and Multilingual VO
clipoRemix.3.detail: Digital presenters, voice cloning and AI voiceover, with multilingual scripts and audio so one piece of content serves several markets.
clipoRemix.4.name: Clipping and Basic Polish
clipoRemix.4.detail: Intelligent long-video clipping plus transitions, captions and motion effects.
fileCollection.0.name: Per-Folder Intake Links
fileCollection.0.detail: Generate an intake link on any folder so contributors can upload without registering an account.
fileCollection.1.name: Filed on Upload
fileCollection.1.detail: Received files land directly in the matching folder, removing the download-and-reupload step.
fileCollection.2.name: Expiry Control
fileCollection.2.detail: Set a validity period so the link closes itself when it expires.
fileCollection.3.name: Password Protection
fileCollection.3.detail: Add an access password to an intake link to control who can submit.
approvalCenter.0.name: Standardised Approval Templates
approvalCenter.0.detail: Preset templates configure approval steps, approvers, time limits and CC lists, and can auto-file approved assets into a chosen folder.
approvalCenter.1.name: Submission and Tracking
approvalCenter.1.detail: Pick a template and the flow and approvers are filled in automatically; To Do, Done, CC’d to Me and Submitted are shown separately for clear progress.
approvalCenter.2.name: Asset-Level Review
approvalCenter.2.detail: Approve or reject individual assets, or select them all at once; annotate on the image, comment and @mention the right people.
approvalCenter.3.name: Full Approval Trail
approvalCenter.3.detail: Every step records approver, outcome, comments and time, and resubmissions continue under the same number for easy traceability.
approvalCenter.4.name: Timeout and Staffing Changes
approvalCenter.4.detail: Overdue approvals transfer automatically to a designated person; if an approver leaves or is removed, the task moves to pending reassignment so the flow keeps moving.
taskWorkflowBasic.title: Task Workflow · Basic
taskWorkflowBasic.0.name: Unified Request Intake
taskWorkflowBasic.0.detail: Requesters submit a standard form covering due date, priority, linked products and reference assets; the request pool is grouped by status and can be filtered, sorted and voided.
taskWorkflowBasic.1.name: Scheduling and Assignment
taskWorkflowBasic.1.detail: Assign requests to specific people and dates with an owner, duration and estimated hours, and review the whole team’s schedule week by week.
taskWorkflowBasic.2.name: Multi-View Task Tracking
taskWorkflowBasic.2.detail: Board, list and calendar views, filterable by assignee, status and priority.
taskWorkflowBasic.3.name: Task Detail and Collaboration
taskWorkflowBasic.3.detail: One task page holds the linked request, reference assets and checklist; assignees upload deliverables directly and the team can comment and @mention.
taskWorkflowBasic.4.name: Clear Role Permissions
taskWorkflowBasic.4.detail: Four permission types — manage, assign, request and execute — granted in bulk by member, department or group.
taskWorkflowBasic.5.name: Please Note
taskWorkflowBasic.5.detail: Adding the Approval Center enables approval steps inside the flow.
taskWorkflowAdvanced.title: Task Workflow · Advanced
taskWorkflowAdvanced.0.name: Marketing Calendar Planning
taskWorkflowAdvanced.0.detail: Maintain marketing moments and timelines by year, quarter and month, filter by department, brand or category, set different visibility scopes, and raise content requests directly from a calendar entry.
taskWorkflowAdvanced.1.name: Standardised Request Intake
taskWorkflowAdvanced.1.detail: Requests are submitted against a common field set or started from a template that fills in size specs, asset requirements, design lead time and deliverables; templates and fields are configurable in the back office.
taskWorkflowAdvanced.2.name: Project-Based Production
taskWorkflowAdvanced.2.detail: A project brings its requests, tasks and delivered assets together, moving through initiation, follow-up, production and archiving, with delivery standards agreed per stage.
taskWorkflowAdvanced.3.name: Scheduling and Resource Management
taskWorkflowAdvanced.3.detail: Plan the team’s week on a Gantt chart; people, venues, brands, props and outsourcing partners are maintained centrally so you can see what is already booked while scheduling.
taskWorkflowAdvanced.4.name: Preset Process Rules
taskWorkflowAdvanced.4.detail: Preset the production flow, storage rules and step owners per request type; accepted requests route automatically, with owner, deadline and current status visible throughout.
taskWorkflowAdvanced.5.name: Permissions and External Collaboration
taskWorkflowAdvanced.5.detail: Four role permissions granted by member, department or group; external partners can be authorised for specific projects without opening up the rest of the system.
taskWorkflowAdvanced.6.name: Please Note
taskWorkflowAdvanced.6.detail: Adding the Approval Center enables approval steps inside the flow.
automationCenter.0.name: Flexible Rule Configuration
automationCenter.0.detail: Each automation is a trigger, a set of filters and one or more actions; filters combine multiple fields and actions can be chained.
automationCenter.1.name: Covers the Asset Lifecycle
automationCenter.1.detail: Triggers on ingest, adding to a folder, metadata change, deletion, approaching expiry and approval, plus scheduled runs.
automationCenter.2.name: Many Action Types
automationCenter.2.detail: Send reminders, start approvals, process assets such as video clipping, move to a folder, retire expired assets, or push to third-party systems via webhook.
automationCenter.3.name: Ready-Made Templates
automationCenter.3.detail: Built-in templates for ingest notifications, expiry reminders, post-approval filing and change pushes; admins can also create their own and control what members may use.
automationCenter.4.name: Auditable Run History
automationCenter.4.detail: Every run records status, duration, assets affected and per-step results, so problems can be traced to the exact step.
automationCenter.5.name: Please Note
automationCenter.5.detail: Approval actions require the Approval Center; social takedown sync requires the matching Social Distribution channel.
brandComplianceAgent.0.name: Visual Compliance Checks
brandComplianceAgent.0.detail: Verify logo version, brand colours and typography against the rules, catching common issues such as the wrong variant, distorted proportions or off-standard colour.
brandComplianceAgent.1.name: Tone of Voice Checks
brandComplianceAgent.1.detail: Compare copy against the brand tone guidelines and flag wording that is off-brand.
brandComplianceAgent.2.name: Issues with Recommendations
brandComplianceAgent.2.detail: Results point to the specific problem and include a suggested fix that can go straight back to design or copy.
brandComplianceAgent.3.name: Please Note
brandComplianceAgent.3.detail: Best used together with the Brand Library.
storeInspectionAgent.title: Store Inspection Agent
storeInspectionAgent.0.name: Signage Type Recognition
storeInspectionAgent.0.detail: Identify signage type from shape and visual features, distinguishing standard templates from seasonal campaign versions.
storeInspectionAgent.1.name: Placement Verification
storeInspectionAgent.1.detail: Check whether signage is displayed in the required position, covering pallet displays, end caps, shelves, chest freezers and upright coolers.
storeInspectionAgent.2.name: Inspection Results
storeInspectionAgent.2.detail: Produce a per-item verdict and a list of failures so supervisors can arrange fixes.
portal.0.name: Separate Portals per Audience
portal.0.detail: Build distinct sites for distributors, media, e-commerce operators, parents and other audiences, each with its own address and content scope.
portal.1.name: Custom Branding and Content
portal.1.detail: Theme colour, cover and welcome message follow your brand rules; content blocks draw from the library, folders or hand-picked assets, with filters and display structure on top.
portal.2.name: Content by Visitor Identity
portal.2.detail: Once authenticated, visitors see the assets relevant to them; multilingual and mobile access are supported.
portal.3.name: Privacy and Usage Control
portal.3.detail: Automatically filter assets flagged as not publicly usable, watermark originals with a visitor number, log downloads, and state usage terms inside the portal.
portal.4.name: Direct Visitor Feedback
portal.4.detail: Enable asset-level and overall feedback entries, customise the options and choose who receives them.
portal.5.name: Permissions and Access Data
portal.5.detail: Internal members get four levels — manage, edit, use and view; portal count, visitor volume and externally shared asset counts are shown together.
portalTheme.title: Portal Theme Customisation
portalTheme.0.name: Designed to Brand Guidelines
portalTheme.0.detail: A portal theme built to your visual guidelines, covering colour, layout and more.
portalTheme.1.name: Covers Key Pages
portalTheme.1.detail: Complete visual and layout design for both list and detail pages.
portalTheme.2.name: Ready on Delivery
portalTheme.2.detail: The theme can be applied to the portal as soon as it is handed over.
portalTheme.3.name: Please Note
portalTheme.3.detail: Purchased on top of the Portal module.
socialArticle.0.name: Edit In-Platform
socialArticle.0.detail: Create and edit WeChat Official Account articles inside the system instead of moving content between tools.
socialArticle.1.name: Rich Layout
socialArticle.1.detail: Layout and styling controls produce content that meets Official Account presentation requirements.
socialArticle.2.name: Assets on Hand
socialArticle.2.detail: Pull images and video straight from the library while editing, with no download-and-reupload.
socialArticle.3.name: Publishing Status at a Glance
socialArticle.3.detail: See the editing and publishing status of every article in one place.
socialAttribution.title: Social Attribution
socialAttribution.0.name: Cross-Platform Data
socialAttribution.0.detail: Aggregate impressions and engagement for published content across social platforms in one view.
socialAttribution.1.name: Traceable to the Asset
socialAttribution.1.detail: Tie performance back to the specific asset and creative version so you can see what actually worked.
socialAttribution.2.name: Side-by-Side Comparison
socialAttribution.2.detail: Compare performance across content and platforms to inform the next round of creative.
ecomAttribution.title: E-commerce Attribution
ecomAttribution.0.name: Cross-Platform Data
ecomAttribution.0.detail: Aggregate impressions, clicks and conversions for products published across e-commerce platforms.
ecomAttribution.1.name: Traceable to the Asset
ecomAttribution.1.detail: Tie conversion back to the specific hero image, detail page or video to identify high-converting assets.
ecomAttribution.2.name: Multi-Dimensional Comparison
ecomAttribution.2.detail: Compare by SKU, platform and asset type to guide asset optimisation and reuse.
notionSync.0.name: Assets Synced to Notion
notionSync.0.detail: Sync a chosen scope of assets to Notion and reference them directly in databases.
notionSync.1.name: Preview In Place
notionSync.1.detail: Assets preview inside Notion, with names, tags and other key details carried over.
feishuDriveBasic.title: Feishu Drive Import · Basic
feishuDriveBasic.0.name: Drive File Import
feishuDriveBasic.0.detail: Import Feishu Drive file links into DAM.
feishuDriveBasic.1.name: Unified Card Display
feishuDriveBasic.1.detail: Imported content appears as cards in the asset library and is managed alongside everything else.
feishuDriveBasic.2.name: Included in Search
feishuDriveBasic.2.detail: Imported content is searchable, categorisable and usable just like the rest of the library.
feishuDriveAdvanced.title: Feishu Drive Import · Advanced
feishuDriveAdvanced.0.name: Doc Link Import
feishuDriveAdvanced.1.name: Automatic Content Extraction
feishuDriveAdvanced.1.detail: Text, images, video and attachments are extracted from the document automatically.
feishuDriveAdvanced.2.name: Split into Usable Assets
feishuDriveAdvanced.2.detail: Extracted content becomes individually searchable assets while keeping the link back to the source document.
feishuBitableOneWay.title: Feishu Bitable · One-Way Sync
feishuBitableOneWay.0.name: Automatic Data Sync
feishuBitableOneWay.0.detail: Asset metadata fields such as project status sync to Feishu Bitable on change, with no manual export or update, keeping both sides consistent.
feishuBitableOneWay.1.name: Configurable Sync Scope
feishuBitableOneWay.1.detail: Choose the target table and field mapping so the data lands the way your team already reports.
feishuBitableOneWay.2.name: Keep Feishu Habits
feishuBitableOneWay.2.detail: Once in Bitable, reuse existing Feishu views, filters, dashboards and automations — no system switch just to check progress.
feishuBitableOneWay.3.name: Please Note
feishuBitableOneWay.3.detail: One-way sync (MuseDAM → Feishu Bitable); edits made in Feishu are not written back.
feishuBitableTwoWay.title: Feishu Bitable · Two-Way Sync
feishuBitableTwoWay.0.name: Automatic Data Sync
feishuBitableTwoWay.0.detail: Asset metadata fields such as project status sync to the chosen Bitable on change, with configurable scope and field mapping, so teams can view and report from Feishu.
feishuBitableTwoWay.1.name: Field-Level Write-Back
feishuBitableTwoWay.1.detail: Admins choose which fields may be written back from the table; the rest stay read-only, and structural data can only change inside the system.
feishuBitableTwoWay.2.name: Executed as the Member
feishuBitableTwoWay.2.detail: Write-backs run under the corresponding system identity and its permissions, so out-of-scope edits are rejected and the integration is never a permission bypass.
feishuBitableTwoWay.3.name: Full Change History
feishuBitableTwoWay.3.detail: Every write-back records who changed what, when, and the before and after values for easy investigation.
feishuApproval.0.name: Approvals as Feishu To-Dos
feishuApproval.0.detail: Approvals raised in the system appear as Feishu to-dos for the approver, with the key points and asset details in the message — no system switch needed to understand the task.
feishuApproval.1.name: Handle It in Feishu
feishuApproval.1.detail: Approvers can approve or reject in Feishu and return to the system when they need the full asset or comment history.
feishuApproval.2.name: Two-Way Write-Back
feishuApproval.2.detail: Decisions made in Feishu write back in real time, updating approval status, asset status and linked task flow so both sides stay consistent.
